messages.text:
I can't refund the Trail running shoes (order d06-o1) yet. The shop's return records don't show them as received back, and the shop only refunds units it has received (refund-policy/v2/return).

- **If you haven't sent them yet:** the shoes have to arrive back at the shop first. Your refund deadline is 2026-10-12 17:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window), and a request made after that would be late.
- **If you've already sent them:** tell me, and I'll pass your case to a staff member to check.
